Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/crawlberg/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	var engineConfig pkg.CrawlConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"browser":{"mode":"always"}}`), &engineConfig); err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("config parse failed: %v", err))
	}
	engine, createErr := pkg.CreateEngine(&engineConfig)
	if createErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("create handle failed: %v", createErr))
	}
	url := `https://example.com`
	var actionsRaw []json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[{"selector":"#open","type":"click"},{"selector":"#field","text":"test_data","type":"type"},{"selector":"#submit","type":"click"}]`), &actionsRaw); err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("config parse failed: %v", err))
	}
	var actions []pkg.PageAction
	for _, raw := range actionsRaw {
		elem, err := pkg.UnmarshalPageAction(raw)
		if err != nil {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("unmarshal PageAction failed: %v", err))
		}
		actions = append(actions, elem)
	}
	result, err := pkg.Interact(engine, url, actions)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[0].ActionIndex)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[0].ActionType)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[0].Success)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[1].ActionIndex)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[1].ActionType)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[1].Success)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[2].ActionIndex)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[2].ActionType)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ActionResults[2].Success)
}
```
